snippet.title: REVEAL TRAILER The Hero of Destiny was killed by the final boss
snippet.description:
The Hero of Destiny was killed by the final boss is an upcoming action RPG from the developer of Silver Falls. In this adventure, the hero is killed even before the story starts. Players will play as the NPCs of the final town in the game, right outside the final dungeon. These characters have no magic and no real weapons or armor... So how many NPCs equal 1 hero? Build your party from more than 50 playable characters and find out!

on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4364210/The_Hero_of_Destiny_was_killed_by_the_final_boss/

Native Linux version https://itch.io/profile/sungrandstudios

Launching on Steam, Switch, and Android.
Learn more about the Battle System: https://youtu.be/L95DRqGksP8
